topics.definition: Diffusion models generate data by learning to gradually remove noise from random samples.
tips: Widely used in modern image generation.

topics.definition: Forward diffusion gradually adds noise to training data.
tips: Noise is added over multiple steps.

topics.definition: Reverse diffusion removes noise step by step to reconstruct data.
tips: The model learns this reverse process.

topics.definition: Latent diffusion performs diffusion in a compressed latent space for efficiency.
Text prompts guide diffusion models to generate matching images.
Diffusion models are used for image generation, editing, restoration and design.
Diffusion models are evaluated using image quality, diversity and metrics such as FID.
tips: Combine automatic metrics with human evaluation.

topics.definition: Use quality datasets, optimize prompts and evaluate outputs regularly.
